values.meaning: nearsight duration (can recast during this window)
values.quote: nearsighting them for 6 seconds, during which their {{tip|sight}} radius is reduced
He can recast ''Paranoia'' for the same duration after {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
values.binNote: No bin row for this recast-availability delay; the sheet's NocturneParanoia entries list only ParanoiaDuration, TrackDistance, BaseDamage and DashSpeed, none of which carry this 0.25s value.

mechanics.claim: The recast is a dash to the target enemy champion that deals the physical damage upon arrival, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: '''Nocturne''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target enemy champion, dealing {{as|physical damage}} upon arrival.

mechanics.claim: Nocturne can cast any of his abilities and item actives during the recast dash, allowing other damage sources to land during it.
mechanics.quote: '''Nocturne''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] and [[Active_ability_items|item actives]] during the dash.

mechanics.claim: The dash has displacement immunity and cannot be deterred by crowd control, but this does not affect damage output timing beyond ensuring the dash completes.
mechanics.quote: The dash cannot be deterred by {{tip|crowd control}}.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown only starts after the recast window times out or the recast is used, not on initial cast.
mechanics.quote: Starts after recast times out or is used

mechanics.claim: Nocturne tracks the target if they change location with no maximum tracking distance, so the dash will always connect.
mechanics.quote: '''Nocturne''' will track the target if they change locations.
